title: Zipp: how to calculate tire pressure
notes: Live rendered-page readback on 2026-10-22. Zipp's calculator guide asks for rider and system weight (including carried luggage) and, for tire width, says to read the label on the tire sidewall, where the second number indicates the width. It also asks for casing type, rim type (hooked, hookless or straight side) and inner rim width before showing pressure suggestions.
